meta.name: SimpleLamp
meta.description: A simplified lamp subclass that inherits the base lamp's power control and lighting effect but provides only stepped brightness adjustment, with no color-temperature state or related operations.

brightness.description: Configured coarse brightness level of the lamp. The value persists while the lamp is off but is publicly accessible only while the lamp is on.

get_brightness.description: Return the configured brightness level. The lamp must be powered on; otherwise the function fails without changing state.

brightness.description: Configured coarse brightness level from 1 through 3.

errorcodes.POWER_OFF: The lamp must be powered on to read brightness.

set_brightness.description: Set brightness to an integer level from 1 through 3. The lamp must be powered on. Invalid input leaves state unchanged.

value.description: Exact coarse brightness level to set.

errorcodes.POWER_OFF: The lamp must be powered on to change brightness.
errorcodes.INVALID_INPUT_ERROR: Brightness must be an integer from 1 through 3.

increase_brightness.description: Increase brightness by the requested number of levels, defaulting to 1. The result is capped at level 3. The lamp must be powered on, and invalid input leaves state unchanged.

value.description: Number of levels by which to increase brightness.

semantics.reason: Increase brightness by the supplied number of levels and cap the resulting brightness at level 3.

errorcodes.POWER_OFF: The lamp must be powered on to increase brightness.
errorcodes.INVALID_INPUT_ERROR: The increase must be an integer of at least 1.

decrease_brightness.description: Decrease brightness by the requested number of levels, defaulting to 1. The result is floored at level 1. The lamp must be powered on, and invalid input leaves state unchanged.

value.description: Number of levels by which to decrease brightness.

semantics.reason: Decrease brightness by the supplied number of levels and floor the resulting brightness at level 1.

errorcodes.POWER_OFF: The lamp must be powered on to decrease brightness.
errorcodes.INVALID_INPUT_ERROR: The decrease must be an integer of at least 1.

after_action.description: The lamp emits an absolute illuminance contribution of zero while powered off. While powered on, its illuminance contribution in lux equals its configured brightness level, so levels 1, 2, and 3 contribute 1, 2, and 3 lux respectively.

effect_properties.name: power
effect_properties.description: Determines whether the lamp contributes illuminance.

effect_properties.name: brightness
effect_properties.description: Determines the lamp's stepped illuminance contribution while powered on.
